typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	totblCalypsoMarkitWireExceptionsProductCapFloor_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		TRADE_ID as decimal(38,0),
		PRODUCT_FAMILY as string,
		PRODUCT_TYPE as string,
		START_DATE as timestamp,
		MATURITY_DATE as timestamp,
		FIXED_RATE as string,
		PRINCIPAL_AMOUNT as double,
		PRINCIPAL_CURRENCY as string,
		PRODUCT_SUB_TYPE as string,
		RATE_INDEX as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> fromproducttables
fromproducttables derive({Copy of PRINCIPAL_AMOUNT} = PRINCIPAL_AMOUNT,
		{Copy of START_DATE} = toString(START_DATE),
		{Copy of PRODUCT_SUB_TYPE} = PRODUCT_SUB_TYPE,
		{Copy of PRODUCT_FAMILY} = PRODUCT_FAMILY,
		{Copy of MATURITY_DATE} = toString(MATURITY_DATE),
		{Copy of TRADE_ID} = toString(TRADE_ID),
		{Copy of PRODUCT_TYPE} = PRODUCT_TYPE,
		{Copy of FIXED_RATE} = FIXED_RATE,
		{Copy of PRINCIPAL_CURRENCY} = PRINCIPAL_CURRENCY,
		{Copy of RATE_INDEX} = RATE_INDEX) ~> DataConversion
DataConversion sink(input(
		fixed_rate as string,
		product_family as string,
		principal_currency as string,
		product_type as string,
		rate_index as string,
		Product_Subtype as string,
		maturity_date as string,
		principal_amount as double,
		TRADE_ID as string,
		start_date as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		fixed_rate = {Copy of FIXED_RATE},
		product_family = {Copy of PRODUCT_FAMILY},
		principal_currency = {Copy of PRINCIPAL_CURRENCY},
		product_type = {Copy of PRODUCT_TYPE},
		rate_index = {Copy of RATE_INDEX},
		Product_Subtype = {Copy of PRODUCT_SUB_TYPE},
		maturity_date = {Copy of MATURITY_DATE},
		principal_amount = {Copy of PRINCIPAL_AMOUNT},
		TRADE_ID = {Copy of TRADE_ID},
		start_date = {Copy of START_DATE}),
	partitionFileNames:[($totblCalypsoMarkitWireExceptionsProductCapFloor_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> totblCalypsoMarkitWireExceptionsProductCapFloor
